meta.title: Auto Loan Calculator — Car Loan Monthly Payment Estimator
meta.description: Calculate your monthly car loan payments based on loan amount, interest rate, and loan term. See total interest and total cost before you buy.

howItWorks: Enter the total loan amount you plan to borrow.
Enter the annual interest rate offered by your lender.
Enter the loan term in months or years.
The calculator uses the standard amortization formula to compute your monthly payment.
howToUse: View your monthly payment, total interest, and total amount payable.

faq.question: What is an EMI?
faq.answer: EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) is the fixed monthly payment you make to repay a loan. It includes both principal and interest.

faq.question: Does this calculator include taxes and fees?
faq.answer: No. This calculator estimates principal and interest only. Taxes, registration, insurance, and fees are not included.

faq.question: Can I compare different loan terms?
faq.answer: Yes. Change the loan term to see how a shorter or longer term affects your monthly payment and total interest.

formula: EMI = [P × R × (1+R)^N] / [(1+R)^N − 1], where P = principal, R = monthly rate, N = months
